description: Get all values of a VisioForge SDK enum type with descriptions. Useful for understanding available options for configuration properties (e.g., MediaBlockType, video codecs, audio formats, pixel formats).

enumName.description: Enum name (e.g., 'MediaBlockType', 'MediaBlockPadMediaType', 'MediaBlockPadDirection'). Can be short name or fully qualified.

filter.description: Optional text filter to show only matching enum values (e.g., 'H264' to find H264-related values)

name: get_enum_values
